milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The lily_of_the_valley is placed at spawn-relative position (4, 0, 3) on a distinctive podzol patch ~5 blocks from spawn. max_distance=5 ensures the player must actually walk to the flower garden rather than trivially triggering from spawn (the flower is at horizontal distance √(4²+3²)=5 from origin). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the flower, confirming they have visually located it.

Uses inventory_has because selling green dye to the villager yields emeralds. The player starts with 16 green dye and 0 emeralds. The cleric villager in the merchant stall has a custom trade: 1 green_dye → 1 emerald. After completing at least one trade, the player will have ≥1 emerald in inventory. This is the most reliable way to detect a completed sell transaction since emeralds cannot be obtained any other way in this scene.
